summary: Jiayin Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 23, 2026, reporting its first quarter 2026 unaudited financial results. The filing discloses net revenue of RMB756.7 million (a 57.4% decrease) and a net loss of RMB61.7 million versus a net income in the prior year. Transaction volume was RMB19.3 billion (down 45.8%). This is a routine earnings release, not a special situation transaction. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change is described. The filing is a standard periodic report for a foreign private issuer.
